text_block_list.text:
"Through the previous investigation, we 
learned that hospitality—in other words, 
customer service—has a huge impact on 
ramen's deliciousness. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright, morning assembly begins now!! 
Osu!!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Oooosh, alright!!

...In order to learn more about 
hospitality, I've decided to train on-site 
at an actual store.

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's repeat the 'Ten 
Commandments of Noodles'!! One: Never 
forget to breathe in sync! One: Pour your 
spirit into the broth—
choice_data_list: (...She's more of a jock than I expected)

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou!! What are you putting into the 
bowl you're making?! Say it!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? I'll—I'll pour a whole bunch into 
it!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text: What are you packing so full of!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A lot of fulls...? I-I'm completely full 
and overwhelmed...!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Then what the heck did you come to do 
so much of when your hands were already 
full!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuum...!? T-Trainer-saaan...
choice_data_list:
In order to become a fine artisan like the 
manager...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It's... to become the shto-ore 
manager!!!!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Y-Youuu!?! Did you come to take my shop 
away from me?!?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeee!?!? N-No, that's not...!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Sounds interesting. If that's the 
case, then show me work with that much 
fighting spirit poured into it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O... Osshu...!?

text_block_list.name: Barrage of Order Calls
text_block_list.text:
"Extra sauce!!" "Extra extra garlic!!" 
"Fat heaven!!" "National unification!!" 
"Avenge my parents!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeee!?!? It-It's a raging tempest of 
chant callssss!?

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Didn't I pound this into your thick 
skull?! Look your customers in the eye and 
engage with them properly!!

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you supposed to become the store 
manager?! Don't go flinching over 
something like this!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I see... I'm going to be the 
manager...!! ...Wait, was I...?

text_block_list.name: Customer's Chant
text_block_list.text:
"Extra sauce!!" "Extra extra garlic!!" 
"Extra fat!!" "200% limit break!!" 
"Entering the atmosphere!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...E-Every single customer is waiting for 
the ramen they want to eat...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"T-Then... a-at least let me do whatever I 
can...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Extra sauce" "Extra sauce" "Extra 
sauce"!! "Extra extra" "Extra extra" 
"Extra extra"!! "Atmosphere" "Atmosphere" 
"Atmosphyere"!!
choice_data_list:
(Repeating every single call... with 
sheer, earnest dedication!?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if a thousand balls come my way...! 
I will return every single one with all my 
might until I collapseeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Extra oil, double quail eggs, veggies 
piled high as Everest, extra extra spicy!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Osu! Extra-extra pork fat, double quail 
eggs, an Everest of veggies, mountain of 
cabbage... extra-extra salty sauce!! 
Coming right up!!"

text_block_list.name: Athletic Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That Doto. She's got that fired-up 
look in her eyes... ready to overthrow the 
throne...!

And so, I somehow powered through the 
training with pure guts and determination, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Opera O-san! Step right up!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, thank you so much for lending 
me a towel!! I shall put it to good use!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...That girl started wrapping a towel 
around her head... What's up with her?
choice_data_list: The fruits of my training... I guess?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh!! Pour your soul into every 
noodle!! Pour your soul into every 
noodle!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the towel's slipping down...! I-I 
can't see what's in front of me!?

...Wobbling erratically, she crashed into 
the rail and tumbled over. Even after 
that, Meisho Doto remained out of sorts 
for a while, continuing her bizarre 
behavior.
